entries.what: Andre left the house at 4:30 a.m. for his first mandatory 10-hour day at RF-4. Rochelle got up with him and packed his two sandwiches and thermos.
entries.outcome: Andre out the door on the new 5 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. schedule.

entries.what: After her morning walk on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk, Rochelle reworked the week's meals around Andre's late return, planning bigger batch dishes from the Sunday cooking.
entries.outcome: New dinner plan taped to the fridge calendar.

entries.what: At the kitchen table after 9 p.m. she built a budget sheet and labeled the van repair 'misc' before showing it to Andre.
entries.outcome: Andre saw the sheet and did not ask about 'misc'.

entries.what: Intro Chemistry at 11 a.m., then lunch from the blue cooler bag in the car in Lot C.
Drove Loretta to her pharmacy run at 3:30, which meant missing Pedro's 4 p.m. study group again.
entries.outcome: Skipped the group; planned to review cards at night.

entries.what: Late at the kitchen table she went through her anatomy index cards by body system.
Anatomy with Dr. Okoye at 9 a.m. and the Wednesday lab, sitting next to Linh.
entries.outcome: Took notes for the upcoming practical.

entries.what: Went to Dr. Okoye's 1 p.m. office hours in S-214 with questions about the lab.
entries.outcome: Got answers on the lab layout.

entries.what: Evening at home; heard about the city council candidate forum on warehouse growth and Measure K from Luisa's voice note but stayed home with the cards.
Chemistry at 11 a.m., then she drafted an email to Denny Wu about her spring plan.
Asked the assistant to just tell her if the email to Denny sounded dumb and only wanted the fix, not commentary.
entries.outcome: Got the fix and sent the email.

entries.what: Kept dinner warm for Andre, who got home after 4 p.m. tired from his long day.
entries.outcome: Ate together early, then he went to bed.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m. with Linh, then a library session on printed handouts.
Keisha called on her 10 a.m. dispatch break, mostly nagging about studying.
Grocery run at Ruiz Family Market for meat for the weekend batch cooking.
First Saturday senior-lunch shift at the Vinca Avenue Community Center, 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. at $18 an hour.
entries.outcome: Finished the shift and learned the routine.

entries.what: Back pain flared after hours on her feet, so she rested at home that afternoon.
Evening with the family while Aaliyah got ready for her Ridgeline shift.
Sunday batch cooking of red beans and rice for the week of long days.
Attended the 11 a.m. service at the Baptist church on Pell Road.
Evening anatomy review at the kitchen table while Andre dozed through football.
